- Risk limit (E1), news reaction (E6), iceberg (LIMIT only), fat finger and stop-out (E2) are each ruled out with tool facts.

Consistency: CLOSE_FP rests on supported market making (registered on SYN.A, two-sided, typical size, symmetric cancels) and on the absence of a benefit (0 price move, no reversion, negative round trip). This matches the closure standard, and memory is used as context only.
